name: Adoption
definition: Share of eligible users who used the tool at least once in the week
window: calendar week; gate reads the latest week, trend over 4 weeks

name: Evaluation pass rate
definition: Share of evaluation cases where the output meets the agreed rubric
denominator: cases run (offline set plus sampled production cases)
provenance: synthetic (UC02 offline baseline: measured on a personal prototype)

name: Override rate
definition: Share of outputs a reviewer changed or rejected before use

name: Task acceptance
definition: Share of tasks completed without rework

name: Critical control incidents
definition: Events where a required control was bypassed or a material error reached a decision

name: Hours saved
definition: Accepted tasks x minutes saved per task / 60
provenance: assumed (minutes per task) x synthetic (tasks); shown with a +/-30% range

name: Model run cost
definition: Model / API charges for the tasks run
source: provider invoices (in this prototype: synthetic weekly cost in telemetry.csv; the UC02 cost per task comes from the personal prototype's own evaluation run log)
provenance: synthetic (UC02 cost per task measured on a personal prototype)

name: Total cost of ownership
definition: Model run cost + licences + infrastructure + support + one-off build and change effort

name: Net value (illustrative)
definition: Hours saved x loaded hourly rate - total cost of ownership
